attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Louisiana state income tax calculation. Implements flat 3% tax structure per LA tax code (2025).

condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "HOH" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "HOH" streq } over not if { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

action_details.action_dsl: set result.la_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.la_standard_deduction) and 0.0
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.la_standard_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.la_taxable_income xdef

action_details.action_comment: Line 11: x .03, rounded to the nearest dollar
action_details.action_dsl: set result.la_tax = the floor of (result.la_taxable_income * la_tax_rate + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.la_taxable_income la_tax_rate fmul 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.la_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Harvested onto the roster by Compute_Roster_State_Tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.la_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.la_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.la_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.la_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: add " Louisiana (IT-540 2025): taxable income $" + result.la_taxable_income + " x 3% = $" + result.la_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Louisiana (IT-540 2025): taxable income $" result.la_taxable_income strconcat " x 3% = $" strconcat result.la_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Louisiana military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per LA Rev. Stat. § 47:293 (2025).
